about: p95 budgets in ms, about 1.5x what was measured when each was set, and never looser than plan 042 began with. The browser suite (web/perf) and the server tests (internal/server) fail past them. On CI runners every budget is multiplied by ciMultiplier.

play-library.interaction: Play a song from the Library

play-library-cell.interaction: Play a song from the Library, clicking a cell

play-album.interaction: Play a song on its album page

island-star.interaction: Star the song playing from the island, on screen

toggle-shuffle.interaction: Shuffle on Now playing, press to Up next reordered

open-album.interaction: Open an album from the Library

library-paint.interaction: Library first rows, from page load

scroll.interaction: Longest frame in a 2 s Library fling

rail-sweep.interaction: Longest frame while the Library sweeps the rail A to Z

trash-song.interaction: Move to Trash from a song's ⋯ menu, press to its row folding

play-shuffle.interaction: Shuffle the library, press to sound

sort-library.interaction: Turn the Library's order round, click to rows

track-change.interaction: A song ends, the next one sounds

album-change.interaction: An album ends, the next down the Library sounds

play-cover.interaction: Play an album from its cover

play-library-cover.interaction: Play an album from its Library cover

column-drag.interaction: Longest frame while dragging a column across the Library header, 2 s

column-drop.interaction: Drop a column, release to rows in their new order

column-key.interaction: Alt+→ on a column header, key to rows in their new order

artist-songs-paint.interaction: Open an artist with 800 songs from its album, click to Top songs' rows

artist-expand.interaction: All N songs, click to the full list's rows

artist-regroup.interaction: An artist's songs, flat to by album, click to rows

play-artist.interaction: Play a song from an artist's flat list

artist-scroll.interaction: Longest frame in a 2 s fling of an artist's 800 songs

resume-island.interaction: Page load to the restored island, paused

play-home-cover.interaction: Play an album from its cover on Home

play-continue.interaction: Pick up where you left off: the Continue card's Play

home-paint.interaction: Back to Home from Albums, click to its rows

open-playlist.interaction: Open a playlist of 500 songs from its card, click to its rows

add-to-playlist.interaction: Add a song to a playlist from its menu, press to the toast

open-smart-playlist.interaction: Open a smart playlist of 500 songs (a text rule over 50k, the 500 least recently played) from its card, click to its rows

edit-rule.interaction: Rules editor: press a star, to the count changed

open-file-playlist.interaction: Open a file playlist of 500 songs (an .m3u8 at the top of the library) from its card, click to its rows

export-download.interaction: Export: press Download on a playlist of 500 songs, to the download starting (the response's first byte)

open-organize.interaction: Organize: click it on the Server page, to the template's chips painted

open-duplicates.interaction: Duplicates: click its tab on Organize, to the first groups painted

preview-paint.interaction: Organize: press Preview over the whole library, to the first album's rows

stream-first-byte.interaction: Stream first byte, FLAC on local disk

artist-index.interaction: GET /library/index?artist=, 825 songs of 50k, default fields, gzip

home-history.interaction: GET /me/home, 217k plays of 50k songs, 43k of them in the last 90 days

smart-preview.interaction: POST /me/playlists/preview, 50k songs: six rules with a group, a genre rule and a limit by least recently played

m3u-read.interaction: Read a 10,000-song .m3u8 against 50k songs, the watcher's targeted scan of its folder

quick-scan-playlists.interaction: Quick scan of 500 unchanged songs and 50 unchanged playlist files

organize-preview.interaction: POST /admin/organize/preview, 50k songs, a fifth of them to move

duplicates-find.interaction: GET /admin/duplicates, 50k songs, 2% in groups, found again after a fingerprint landed

organize-run.interaction: An organize run of 1,000 songs in 100 albums, all moved and journaled, per song

gain-run.interaction: A ReplayGain run of 1,000 FLACs in 100 albums, written in place, read back and journaled, per song

gain-status.interaction: GET /admin/replaygain, 50k songs, 2,000 of them to write

artist-detail.interaction: GET /artists/{id} with all four images and a bio, 50k songs, gzip

artists-list.interaction: GET /artists, 2,000 artists each with a thumb, 50k songs, gzip

quick-scan-art.interaction: Quick scan of 500 unchanged songs, 50 artist folders and 50 album folders of unchanged art

scrape-artist.interaction: The artist pass over one artist, every source on, against stand-ins: JSON, choices, a 1000 px thumb, a 4K background, a logo and a banner rendered, a bio, one write
